nodes.title: revise-hypothesis refuses a case slug with no open draft version
nodes.summary: Closes revise-hypothesis.operation.ts's own disclosed UNDERDETERMINED gap by reading the case's current draft version before doing anything else and refusing through a new typed error when none exists.

nodes.title: Proof for revise-hypothesis-draft-gate/refuse-without-draft
nodes.summary: Tests ReviseHypothesisOperation's new draft gate (never-drafted, already-released and already-discarded refusal, and success when a draft coexists with release history) in revise-hypothesis.operation.spec.ts, fixes that same file's own pre-existing criteria-1-through-5 fixtures to seed a draft so the gate does not confound them, and separately adds ICaseStore.findDraftVersion to FakeCaseStore in case-query.service.spec.ts purely so the project still typechecks — a build fix, not a test.
